label: Article 2
title: The Second Commandment
path: Chapter One: You Shall Love the Lord Your God with All Your Heart, and with All Your Soul, and with All Your Mind

r: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain.
You have heard that it was said to the men of old, "You shall not swear falsely. . But I say to you, Do not swear at all.
